description: CreatorOS 13-layer production stack design — desired end state, current state, gaps, and readiness

layers.desired_end_state: React 18 + Vite 5 + TypeScript + shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS. Creator dashboard, content management, community features, course/product delivery UI. Responsive design. Dark mode.
layers.current_state: React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + shadcn/ui + Tailwind. Replit-origin structure. God files present (routes.ts, storage.ts are monolithic). Basic creator UI exists but scope unclear relative to PRD.
layers.gap: God files need splitting. MVP scope undefined (DEC-145-002). Repo bloat from Replit origin. UI completeness unclear until MVP scope is decided.
layers.shared_standard_applicability: React/Vite/TypeScript/shadcn/Tailwind from OS Platform Standard v2
layers.app_specific_notes: CreatorOS frontend exists but quality is unknown due to god files and Replit origin. MVP scope decision determines which frontend features are required.

layers.desired_end_state: Express 4 + TypeScript API server. RESTful endpoints for creator profiles, content management, courses, community, analytics. Request validation. Typed contracts.
layers.current_state: Express server exists. Routes consolidated in god files. Basic CRUD for creator-related entities. No request validation beyond TypeScript types. Replit-origin code quality.
layers.gap: God file splitting required. Route organization unclear. No API documentation. No request validation middleware. Quality of existing routes unknown.
layers.shared_standard_applicability: Express/TypeScript/Drizzle from OS Platform Standard v2
layers.app_specific_notes: Backend logic quality is a concern. Replit Agent authored code needs review. God files make it hard to assess individual route quality.

layers.desired_end_state: Neon Postgres. Drizzle ORM schema. Separate CreatorOS database. Schema covers: users, creators, content, courses, community, subscriptions, media storage references.
layers.current_state: Drizzle schema exists. Database tables defined. No production Neon database provisioned. Schema quality and completeness unknown relative to MVP scope.
layers.gap: No production database. Schema may need revision after MVP scope decision. No migration path to production. No backup strategy.
layers.shared_standard_applicability: Neon Postgres + Drizzle ORM from OS Platform Standard v2
layers.app_specific_notes: CreatorOS database must be separate from EOS and LyfeOS. Schema needs review once MVP scope is decided.

layers.desired_end_state: Clerk authentication. Role-based access (creator vs consumer). Session management via Clerk. OAuth providers. Secure password handling eliminated (Clerk manages credentials).
layers.current_state: CRITICAL VULNERABILITY: comparePasswords() returns true for all passwords. Passport.js session-based auth is broken/legacy. Auth is completely non-functional as a security boundary. Any password works for any user account.
layers.gap: CRITICAL — auth bypass vulnerability. comparePasswords returns true for all passwords. Passport.js must be fully replaced with Clerk. This is the highest-priority security issue across all Trinity apps.
layers.implementation_status: BLOCKED — auth migration execution blocked. Security repair is P0 but cannot execute in 14.5A.
layers.shared_standard_applicability: Clerk auth direction from OS Platform Standard v2
layers.app_specific_notes: CreatorOS auth is the most critical security issue in the entire Trinity portfolio. comparePasswords returning true means any user can log in as any other user. This app CANNOT be deployed until auth is fixed. Clerk migration is the permanent fix. Emergency auth disable or temporary fix may be needed as a stopgap if the app is accessible.

layers.desired_end_state: Fly.io deployment. Dockerized application. Production environment. Health check endpoint. Zero-downtime deploys.
layers.current_state: No production deployment. No Dockerfile. No Fly.io configuration. Development only.
layers.gap: Complete gap. No deployment infrastructure. CANNOT deploy until auth bypass is fixed.
layers.implementation_status: BLOCKED — no deployment in 14.5A. Auth bypass blocks any deployment.
layers.shared_standard_applicability: Fly.io deployment from OS Platform Standard v2
layers.app_specific_notes: CreatorOS MUST NOT be deployed to any public URL until the auth bypass is fixed. Even staging/preview deployments are dangerous with the current auth vulnerability.
validation_requirements: Auth bypass eliminated BEFORE any deploy

layers.desired_end_state: Fly.io for application hosting. Neon for managed Postgres. Clerk for managed auth. CDN for static assets.
layers.current_state: No cloud compute provisioned. Development on Beast only.
layers.gap: Complete gap. All compute is local.
layers.shared_standard_applicability: Fly.io + Neon + Clerk from OS Platform Standard v2
layers.app_specific_notes: Similar to EOS — single Fly machine, Neon database, Clerk auth. No heavy compute requirements.

layers.desired_end_state: GitHub as version control. GitHub Actions CI/CD. Automated build, test, lint on PR. Automated deployment on main merge. Branch protection.
layers.current_state: GitHub repo exists. No CI/CD pipeline. No GitHub Actions. No branch protection. No automated testing. GitHub main and Beast are aligned (no branch divergence like EOS).
layers.gap: No CI/CD. No automated pipeline. No test suite to run in CI.
layers.shared_standard_applicability: GitHub + GitHub Actions from OS Platform Standard v2
layers.app_specific_notes: Unlike EOS, CreatorOS does not have a branch divergence problem. Source is aligned between GitHub and Beast.

layers.desired_end_state: RLS on all user-scoped tables. CSRF protection. XSS prevention. SQL injection prevention. Security headers. HTTPS. Secret management. Auth vulnerability eliminated.
layers.current_state: CRITICAL — auth bypass means no security boundary exists. No RLS. No security headers. No CSP. Drizzle provides parameterized queries (SQL injection mitigated). React XSS prevention (default).
layers.gap: CRITICAL — the entire security layer is compromised by the auth bypass. RLS is meaningless if any user can authenticate as any other user. Auth fix is prerequisite for all security work.
layers.shared_standard_applicability: RLS + security headers from OS Platform Standard v2
layers.app_specific_notes: CreatorOS handles creator content, user data, and potentially payment-related information. Security is non-negotiable. The auth bypass makes the entire security posture invalid. Fix auth first, then layer security.

layers.desired_end_state: Rate limiting on all public endpoints. Strict limits on auth, write, and AI endpoints. Moderate limits on read endpoints.
layers.current_state: No rate limiting. All endpoints unprotected.
layers.shared_standard_applicability: Rate limiting middleware from OS Platform Standard v2
layers.app_specific_notes: Rate limiting is less urgent for CreatorOS than auth fix but required before production.

layers.desired_end_state: CDN for static assets. API caching for expensive queries. Browser caching headers.
layers.current_state: No CDN. No caching. Development only.
layers.shared_standard_applicability: CDN + caching from OS Platform Standard v2
layers.app_specific_notes: CreatorOS may serve media content (creator uploads) which benefits from CDN. Media storage strategy affects caching design.

layers.desired_end_state: Fly.io auto-scaling. Health check routing. Database connection pooling.
layers.shared_standard_applicability: Fly.io scaling + Neon pooling from OS Platform Standard v2
layers.app_specific_notes: Low priority until traffic justifies it.

layers.desired_end_state: Structured logging. Error tracking (Sentry or equivalent). PostHog for product analytics. Error alerting.
layers.current_state: No structured logging. No error tracking. No analytics. Console.log only.
layers.shared_standard_applicability: PostHog + error tracking from OS Platform Standard v2
layers.app_specific_notes: Same observability question as EOS — PostHog for analytics, but what covers error tracking?

layers.desired_end_state: Automated backups. Deployment rollback. Recovery runbook. Uptime monitoring.
layers.shared_standard_applicability: Neon backups + Fly.io rollback from OS Platform Standard v2

summary.primary_blocker: Auth bypass vulnerability (comparePasswords returns true) blocks all deployment and security layers. MVP scope (DEC-145-002) blocks feature layers.
